thread:
maria-ops: Heads up — payment processor put Fintown (acct: fintown_inc) on a temporary payout hold after three dispute filings this morning. Processor flagged dispute reason: "unrecognized" from the cardholder. Need to gather evidence and decide whether to represent or refund. :eyes:

leah-billing: Sending tx list now. Descriptor on our side is 'REDW-INFER' which might be unclear to some cardholders. I pulled the transactions:```
tx_id,amount,last4,auth_code,descriptor,email
tr_9921,125.00,4242,AUTH83,REDW-INFER,acct.admin@fintown.com
tr_9922,300.00,4242,AUTH85,REDW-INFER,billing@fintown.com
tr_9923,49.99,4242,AUTH87,REDW-INFER,ops@fintown.com
```

billing-bot: chargeback created cb_2028_01 for tr_9921 (reason: unrecognized). Processor case id: PROC-55421.

kevin-fraud: Thanks. Quick Qs: were these card-present lookups or pure MOTO/online? Any pattern on IPs or device? Also need BIN range and any previous auth reversals. If it's a descriptor confusion case we can try representment + clearer merchant statement + evidence of service.

leah-billing: All online, same billing IP (203.0.113.45) within a 15-min window. No auth reversals. BIN: 400000-400999. No prior disputes from this account this quarter.

oliver-customer-success: FYI I chatted with the Fintown ops contact. They said one user emailed claiming they didn't recognize the charge and requested a refund. They don't have a signed TOS acceptance for that user — but they do have an in-app invoice and usage log.

kevin-fraud: Good. Plan: assemble representment packet for processor with (1) itemized invoice showing product/service and dates, (2) customer email confirming use, (3) full descriptor + screenshot of billing page, (4) IP + auth. If descriptor confusion, we have a decent chance. If cardholder says fraud, tougher.

maria-ops: Leah — can you attach the invoice PDF and the latest usage logs to this thread? Also include the support exchange (redacted PII ok). I'll draft the representment letter once we have files. We have ~6 business days to respond.

leah-billing: Uploaded invoice and usage log to the secure bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/fintown/1880012345/. I'll DM the link to kevin and maria.

kevin-fraud: If we represent, use reason code '4837 - Merchandise/Services Rendered' and call out descriptor mismatch. I'll prep the letter. If anyone sees a clear sign of fraud (multiple cards, velocity across BINs), shout now.

oliver-customer-success: Fintown is willing to offer a goodwill partial refund if representment fails — they asked about how that affects their processor risk.

maria-ops: Noted. Let's wait for the invoice and support logs. If kevin gives go, finance can approve up to $125 refund as one-off without escalation. Anything above needs leadership sign-off.

leah-billing: Files in place. Ready for representment packet.

kevin-fraud: I reviewed the logs — single card last4 4242, single IP, consistent usage. I'm comfortable we should try representment first. Maria, please approve sending.

maria-ops: Approved. Kevin, send representment to processor and cc leah. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

leah-billing: Will track outcome and update ledger once resolved. Creating internal ticket FIN-5421 to reconcile if processor returns funds.

oliver-customer-success: I'll follow up with Fintown about adding clearer billing descriptors and copy for invoices to reduce future confusion.

kevin-fraud: Sent to processor. Case PROC-55421 updated with representment packet. ETA from processor ~7-10 days.

maria-ops: Great — closing the loop here. Please ping if any new disputes from this merchant pop up.
